messages:
Maria: Quick post-all-hands follow-up 14 thanks for the great questions today. I captured the highest-impact asks and assigned owners. TL;DR: timeline clarifications, a couple of doc gaps, and two action tickets. Deck + recording: https://redwood-inference.internal/ah/mar-23-deck

Alex: Can we clarify Dedicated GA timeline and what SLA were promising customers? A few folks pinged me after the call.

Maria: Short answer: target public GA for Dedicated v1 is mid-May 2026, with a staged rollout to existing beta accounts the week prior. SLA goal for v1: 99.95% uptime for reserved clusters (more stringent SLOs for priority customers discussed in contracts). Roadmap ticket: https://redwood-inference.internal/roadmap/3421 (contains rollout gating criteria).

Sam: Who owns the autoscaling policy defaults for Dedicated? We need sane defaults for burst capacity and a note about cost deltas in the console.

Jordan: Sam should own the defaults; Jordan and I can pair to add the cost delta UI in Console.

Sam: Sounds good. I'll draft default policies and a short explainer. ETA: EOW (Fri).

Elaine: Quick security clarifications from the Q&A: Private deployment audit logs are currently set to 90 days by default. Longer retention is available as an enterprise add-on (config + pricing). Customer-managed KMS/HSM support for Private control plane is scheduled to land in the early-April patch (private customers only). I'll post the security checklist once the KMS integration PR is merged.

Alex: Thanks Elaine 14 will that require customer network changes?

Elaine: Minimal. Customers must expose their KMS endpoint to the control plane (VPC peering or proxy). We'll include an example in the Private quickstart.

Jordan: Action: create a Private quickstart snippet showing KMS + audit log retention. I'll take this and link it in the docs.

Maria: Jordan  can you attach the snippet to the Console docs and add a clear note about retention tiers? Owner + ETA?

Jordan: Assigned to me. ETA: next Wednesday.

ops-bot: Created ticket https://redwood-inference.internal/issue/5678  "Dedicated autoscale defaults + console cost delta explainer" assigned to Sam and Jordan, due 2026-04-03.

deploy-bot: Canary window for Dedicated rollout scheduled: 2026-05-09 -> 2026-05-13, region us-east-1 primary. Fallback policy: auto-rollback on 5xx spike >0.5% for 10m.

Maria: Two follow-ups from leadership Qs: 1) Eval program  we will publish benchmark profiles for the top 5 open models by April 6. 2) Partner integrations  commercial partners list will be posted to the partner page by end of April.

Elaine: I'll open the security RFC for KMS/HSM integration and link it to ticket 5678.

Sam: Posting a short snippet for Console cost callout (feel free to reuse):
```
Cost note: Reserved capacity billing reflects committed vCPU/GPU-hours. Burst usage is billed at on-demand rate; expect ~1.2x unit cost during burst window.
```

Maria: Closing notes  owners: Sam (autoscale defaults, due 2026-04-03), Jordan (Private quickstart + docs, due 2026-04-08), Elaine (KMS RFC, due 2026-03-31). I'll run a short sync next Tuesday to confirm progress. If anyone wants to volunteer to help with docs or customer comms, ping me. :thumbsup:
